name: provenmap
description: ProvenMap plugins for codebase and knowledge architecture analysis, visualization, and sync to ProvenMap Portal.

metadata.description: ProvenMap plugins for codebase and knowledge architecture analysis, visualization, and sync to ProvenMap Portal.

plugins.name: pmap-code
plugins.description: Real-time codebase architecture analysis and visualization for ProvenMap Portal. Analyzes codebases across multiple languages, detects tech stacks, identifies component relationships, and syncs to ProvenMap for collaborative architecture boards. Supports server-defined insight analysis skills.

plugins.name: pmap-connect
plugins.description: Grounding connector for ProvenMap. Binds a document/knowledge repo to architect-authored boards: maintains node↔document evidence links, reports drift when documents change underneath the board, runs server-defined insight analysis, and implements architect-authored intents by editing the documents. Produces no boards — the architect authors them.

plugins.name: pmap-architect
plugins.description: Architect workbench for ProvenMap boards — explore the board graph, review insights, and author intents from Claude Cowork, Claude Code, or Codex. Connects to the ProvenMap MCP server; writes gather in your working copy, and committing generates a reviewable plan (one intent per governed app).
